{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"caller":{"type":"direct"},"id":"toolu_01TLwVTPjpJFo4X2kJV1AnY8","input":{"file_path":"/logs/agent/sessions/projects/-/memory/questdb-pgwire-bare-keyword-functions.md","content":"---\nname: questdb-pgwire-bare-keyword-functions\ndescription: How QuestDB resolves bare (parenthesis-less) SQL keyword functions like current_catalog / current_schema\nmetadata:\n  type: project\n---\n\nIn questdb/questdb, a PG-wire client sending a bare keyword function (e.g. `select current_catalog`, no parens) only works if a zero-arg FunctionFactory is registered for that name. Mechanism: `SqlOptimiser.rewriteTopLevelLiteralsToFunctions` calls `FunctionFactoryCache.isValidNoArgFunction`, which returns true when some overload has `getSigArgCount() == 0`; the literal node is then retyped to FUNCTION. Otherwise `FunctionParser.createColumn` throws \"Invalid column: <name>\". Factories are auto-discovered by classpath scan (`FunctionFactoryScanner`) of package `io.questdb.griffin.engine.functions.catalogue` — no manual registration file.\n\n**Why:** The pgjdbc 42.7.7 upgrade (from 42.7.4) made `Connection.getCatalog()` issue `select current_catalog`, which QuestDB previously didn't support, breaking `PGJobContextTest.testMetadata` (\"Invalid column: current_catalog\"). Fix was adding `CurrentCatalogFunctionFactory` (signature `current_catalog()`, returns `Constants.DB_NAME` = \"qdb\", same as `current_database()`).\n\n**How to apply:** To add a new bare PG keyword function, drop a FunctionFactory with a `name()` (zero-arg) signature into the catalogue package — scan + no-arg rewrite handle the rest. See [[questdb-postgres-driver-upgrade]].\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_01X1pmgzPRwqy5cxGLxb2Fiv","model":"claude-opus-4-8","role":"assistant","stop_details":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":291},"cache_creation_input_tokens":291,"cache_read_input_tokens":96162,"inference_geo":"global","input_tokens":131,"output_tokens":3},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3ba47696-4c7d-47e4-841a-79ad9dc8bec7","uuid":"6d79678f-ffbd-4052-b804-c1359b93d3ee"}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01TLwVTPjpJFo4X2kJV1AnY8","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-/memory/questdb-pgwire-bare-keyword-functions.md (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3ba47696-4c7d-47e4-841a-79ad9dc8bec7","uuid":"1db9ccd4-58a8-449c-986f-73ed94500320","timestamp":"2026-07-02T07:33:40.019Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/logs/agent/sessions/projects/-/memory/questdb-pgwire-bare-keyword-functions.md","content":"---\nname: questdb-pgwire-bare-keyword-functions\ndescription: How QuestDB resolves bare (parenthesis-less) SQL keyword functions like current_catalog / current_schema\nmetadata: \n  node_type: memory\n  type: project\n  originSessionId: 3ba47696-4c7d-47e4-841a-79ad9dc8bec7\n---\n\nIn questdb/questdb, a PG-wire client sending a bare keyword function (e.g. `select current_catalog`, no parens) only works if a zero-arg FunctionFactory is registered for that name. Mechanism: `SqlOptimiser.rewriteTopLevelLiteralsToFunctions` calls `FunctionFactoryCache.isValidNoArgFunction`, which returns true when some overload has `getSigArgCount() == 0`; the literal node is then retyped to FUNCTION. Otherwise `FunctionParser.createColumn` throws \"Invalid column: <name>\". Factories are auto-discovered by classpath scan (`FunctionFactoryScanner`) of package `io.questdb.griffin.engine.functions.catalogue` — no manual registration file.\n\n**Why:** The pgjdbc 42.7.7 upgrade (from 42.7.4) made `Connection.getCatalog()` issue `select current_catalog`, which QuestDB previously didn't support, breaking `PGJobContextTest.testMetadata` (\"Invalid column: current_catalog\"). Fix was adding `CurrentCatalogFunctionFactory` (signature `current_catalog()`, returns `Constants.DB_NAME` = \"qdb\", same as `current_database()`).\n\n**How to apply:** To add a new bare PG keyword function, drop a FunctionFactory with a `name()` (zero-arg) signature into the catalogue package — scan + no-arg rewrite handle the rest. See [[questdb-postgres-driver-upgrade]].\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
